children.game_version: A garden-based movement game focusing on the 'flower picking' aspect of the Perak variant.

seniors.seated_version: Perform hand gestures while seated in a supportive chair.
seniors.standing_version: Not recommended due to balance requirements.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo; focus on hand gestures only.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Palace throne room or palace garden.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Continuous circular movement; torso arches backward.
movement_profile.posture: Standing, with an acrobatic backward arch.

signature_moves.description: The dancer arches their body backward while standing until their face looks toward the floor.
signature_moves.name: Bending

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not attempt the backward bending without proper physical training and supervision.

music_profile.sound_description: The music is driven by the Gendang Terinai, featuring a rhythmic interplay of drums, gongs, and flutes, supporting the three core songs: Temang Welo, Selong, and Mak Inang.

teaching.formation: Historically performed by two men; palace maids perform in gardens.
teaching.level_notes: Advanced: requires significant flexibility for the bending position.
